personality_one_liner: A clinical, high-performance command center for athletes, built on uncompromising precision, deep dark surfaces, and energetic neon accents.

spacing.rule: Maintain tight, clinical grouping (sm/md) for metric clusters and generous padding (xl/2xl) around major layout blocks. Ensure all tap targets are min 44x44pt.

do's: Use only for subtle modal scrims if absolutely necessary.
dont's: No frosted glass for dashboard cards, headers, or nav. This is Dark-First Utility; rely on solid surface hexes and dividers for peak contrast.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Secure entry for athletes and physiotherapists.

states.error: Inline text below inputs with Retry button.

screens.layout: Hero image background with dark scrim (top-to-bottom gradient). Logo mark top-center. Email/Password inputs wrapped in surfaceTertiary blocks. Large brandPrimary 'Login' CTA, followed by Google Auth secondary CTA.

screens.name: Athlete Onboarding & Profiling
screens.purpose: Collect baseline clinical data: sport, surgery type, post-op time, dominant arm.
screens.layout: Single-column scrollable form. Segmented controls for Sex/Dominant Arm. Chips (brandTertiary) for Surgery Type. Numeric text inputs for age/time. Sticky CTA at the bottom above safe area.

screens.name: Assessment Flow (5-Blocks)
screens.purpose: Step-by-step guided RTS protocol (Psychology, ROM, Strength LSI, Functional, Sport-Specific).
screens.layout: Paginated wizard layout (horizontal pager dots top). Each block is a dedicated screen to prevent scroll fatigue. SIRSI uses track sliders (0-100%). Dynamometry uses precise numeric text inputs with adjacent +/- steppers. Text-only instructions in surfaceSecondary cards. Sticky 'Next' CTA at bottom.

screens.name: Analytics Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display final RTS score, radar chart profile, weak links, and AI action plan.

states.empty: Illustration of clipboard + 'Take your first RTS test'.

screens.layout: Top section: Large Circular Gauge (color-coded red/yellow/green based on score). Middle: 5-axis Radar chart (surfaceSecondary card). Lower sections: 'Weak Links' list (highlighting LSI < 90%) and 'Roadmap' cards (3 exercises + retest date). Use SportSee/Recharts logic for radar chart.

screens.name: Test History
screens.purpose: Log of previous assessments for progress tracking.

states.empty: No tests logged yet. 'Start Assessment' button.

screens.layout: Vertical list of cards. Each card shows Date, RTS Score (large font, color-coded), and top-level summary. Tap opens read-only detailed dashboard.

auth_hero.alt: Dark gym background / abstract dark neon backdrop

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility (Personality 7) rules. The app must be in dark mode by default.
Typography: Use Rajdhani for all metrics, scores, and large headers to give a highly clinical, athletic feel. Use IBM Plex Sans for legibility in instructions and forms.
Avoid glassmorphism/blur. Depend on solid surface hierarchy (surface, surfaceSecondary, surfaceTertiary) and 1px dividers to separate content. Ensure maximum readability during active gym use.
Color constraints: Neon Lime (`#ccff00`) is the sole energetic brand accent. Use semantic colors (success/warning/error) strictly for RTS status indicators in the circular gauge and metric readouts.
Form UX: For the 5-block assessment flow, implement a paginated wizard structure. Do not place all blocks on one long scrolling screen. Use sticky buttons at the bottom.

Metrics UX: For quantitative tests (ROM, Dynamometry), use explicit text inputs with +/- steppers rather than sliders for precision. Reserve sliders exclusively for subjective 0-100% scores (SIRSI questionnaire).
Data Viz: Utilize Recharts (or similar) to construct the Circular Gauge and the 5-axis Radar chart (Psychology, Mobility, Strength, Stability, Power) as requested in the dashboard layout.
